description_en: Modifies the permissions of a database account
description_zh: 修改某一数据库账户的权限
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-account-privileges --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-bp1k5p066e1a0000 --account-name account1 --account-privileges '[{"PrivilegeObject":{},"Privileges":["select"],"PrivilegeType":"Global"}]' --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAccountPrivileges

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account
parameters.name: account_name

fields.help_en: The columns on which you want to grant permissions. This parameter must be specified when the PrivilegeType parameter is set to Column
fields.help_zh: 授权的列，当为列权限级别时此参数必传
fields.name: column

fields.help_en: The databases on which you want to grant permissions. This parameter must be specified when the PrivilegeType parameter is set to Database, Table, or Column
fields.help_zh: 授权的数据库，当为库、表和列权限级别时此参数必传
fields.name: database

fields.help_en: The tables on which you want to grant permissions. This parameter must be specified when the PrivilegeType parameter is set to Table or Column
fields.help_zh: 授权的表，当为表和列权限级别时此参数必传
fields.name: table

fields.help_en: The objects on which you want to grant permissions, including databases, tables, and columns
fields.help_zh: 权限对象，为库表列的三元组
fields.name: privilege_object

fields.help_en: The permission level that you want to assign to the database account. You can call the `DescribeEnabledPrivileges` operation to query the permission level that can be assigned to the database account
fields.name: privilege_type

fields.help_en: The permissions that you want to grant to the database account
fields.name: privileges

parameters.help_en: The permissions that you want to grant to the database account
parameters.name: account_privileges
